purpose: test whether the v0.3 source-decoupling state marks a reference gap already present in the frozen R3 held-out predictions, without using the fitted candidate C as the response

analysis_population.selection_rule: all five frozen folds evaluable; no selection by candidate direction

reference_gap_response.definition: observed - p_R3 on frozen held-out rows
reference_gap_response.interpretation: positive values mean the already-frozen strong reference underpredicts occurrence probability on average; this is a calibration residual, not a causal or demographic residual

predictor_only_states.source_conditioned_minus_generic: species-conditioned EOG connected frequency minus generic mainland stepping frequency, both reconstructed using the frozen 25/50/125/250-km graph ensemble and outer-training sources only
predictor_only_states.excess_connectivity: species-conditioned EOG frequency > generic mainland stepping frequency
predictor_only_states.multihop25: connected to an outer-training occupied source in the 25-km component while nearest outer-training source distance exceeds 25 km

model.estimator: OLS on two-way-demeaned held-out calibration residual
model.uncertainty: Cameron-Gelbach-Miller two-way cluster-robust covariance: species cluster + island cluster - cell contribution

E15_reference_gap_source_decoupling.interpretation: Within the same remote islands and after removing species-wide and island-wide mean differences, R3 underprediction is larger in source-decoupled and multi-hop states. The direct-within-25-km state is not comparably detected in this diagnostic.

E16_reference_gap_not_nearest_source_dis.interpretation: The source-decoupling reference gap persists after an explicit within-panel adjustment for nearest outer-training source distance. This supports path-state information beyond direct source distance, while not proving a realized movement mechanism.

E17_spatial_fold_robustness.interpretation: The reference-gap alignment is independently present in the two remote folds containing almost all excess-connectivity rows. The small fold-5 excess subset is not detected and is retained as a boundary rather than hidden.

E18_mechanistic_synthesis.statement: The v0.3 source-decoupling state identifies a calibration gap in the strong reference itself, not merely a favourable behaviour of the fitted topology-augmented model.
E18_mechanistic_synthesis.ecological_hypothesis: When generic mainland connectivity weakens but an occupied insular source path remains intact, a strong area-isolation-source reference can systematically underrepresent occurrence support because direct source distance and generic stepping do not encode focal-species path continuity.
E18_mechanistic_synthesis.evidence_boundary: held-out reference-gap alignment only; no realized dispersal, colonization, rescue, or persistence is observed

updated_ecological_synthesis: The strongest current ecological hypothesis is no longer generic extreme-isolation importance; it is source-network decoupling under extreme isolation.
Species-conditioned path state predicts a residual gap in the already-frozen R3 reference before candidate-C performance is consulted.
Multi-hop source paths retain this reference-gap association after nearest-source distance is adjusted, supporting path continuity as information not reducible to direct source proximity.
The effect is strong in the two remote spatial folds that contain almost all source-decoupled rows and absent in the tiny third remote subset, so cross-landscape generality remains unproven.

The existing future 75% isolation primary and v0.3 mechanistic secondaries are sufficient to test this hypothesis prospectively; further mining of the same A-Islands/Tanzania outcomes would mainly increase researcher degrees of freedom.
claim_ceiling: do not interpret observed-minus-p_R3 as demographic growth, colonization or persistence
do not claim source-decoupling proves use of stepping-stone islands
do not hide the non-detected remote fold-5 boundary
do not change the frozen 75% future primary
do not elevate source-decoupling or multi-hop diagnostics into a retrospective primary
do not add further same-data subgroup or threshold searches after the v0.4 exploratory freeze
